data.name: Prithiviraaj
data.gender_notes: Prithiviraaj is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Prithiviraaj is a Sanskrit name meaning 'King of the Earth'. It is derived from the words 'prithvi' (earth) and 'raaj' (king). This powerful name is mentioned in various Hindu scriptures and mythology, where Prithiviraaj is depicted as the king of the earth and the ruler of all beings. The name Prithiviraaj carries the meaning “King of Earth” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Prithiviraaj usually hope their child will grow to embody king of earth and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Prithiviraaj belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “King of Earth.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Prithiviraaj total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

data.cultural_impact: The name Prithiviraaj holds great cultural significance in Hindu society. It is believed that those who bear this name are bestowed with the might and power of a king, and are responsible for protecting and ruling over their people and land with integrity and wisdom. This name is often given to children in the hope that they will grow up to be strong, just, and compassionate leaders. It is also a popular name for royal and noble characters in Hindu literature and mythology.
data.spiritual_significance: Spiritually, the name Prithiviraaj represents the connection between the human being and the earth. It highlights the importance of recognizing the earth as our fundamental source of life and nourishment. Prithiviraaj also signifies the idea of union with the divine energies of the earth, which can bring about inner strength, stability, and nourishment. As such, those named Prithiviraaj are encouraged to cultivate a deep respect for the earth and its rhythms, as well as to embody the qualities of a just and compassionate ruler in their own lives.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Prithvi signifies the Earth, Raaj represents rule or reign. Thus, Prithiviraaj symbolizes one who rules over the Earth. A monarch in touch with the earthly realm, embodying stability and nurturing power.

vedic_reference.root_origin: Sanskrit: पृथिवी (pṛthivī) - Earth, राज (rāj) - King, राजा (rājā) - Ruler

historical_references.reference: Prithiviraaj Chauhan was a king of the Chauhan Rajput dynasty, who ruled the Ajmer-Merwara region from 1179 to 1192 CE. He is best known for his unsuccessful attempts to conquer the Delhi Sultanate and the Ghurid Empire during the Second Battle of Tarain.
historical_references.context: Medieval India, Rajput dynasty, Battle of Tarain, Ghurid Empire

historical_references.reference: Prithiviraaj III was the last great ruler of the Western Chalukya Empire, reigning from 1234 to 1271 CE. He is known for his patronage of Jainism and his efforts to expand the empire's territories, which included the conquest of the Hoysala kingdom.
historical_references.context: Medieval India, Western Chalukya Empire, Jainism, Hoysala kingdom

modern_usage.modern_context: The name 'Prithiviraaj' is derived from Hindu mythology, where Prithvi is the God of the Earth and Raaj means king. This name has gained modern popularity across various platforms. In literature, there have been numerous books and stories written around the life and legend of Prithiviraaj Chola, a historical king who ruled the Chola Empire during the 11th century. In television, shows like 'Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj' and 'Prithviraj Raso' have depicted the tales of Prithiviraaj, showcasing his valor and leadership. In gaming, 'Prithiviraaj Chola' is a playable character in the strategy game 'Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition', allowing players to experience his strategic abilities and rulership skills.

name_in_real_life.story: Krishna Prithiviraaj from Bangalore, India embodies the meaning of Prithiviraaj - "King of Earth". Growing up in a Hindu family, they were taught to honor the spiritual significance of their name and live according to dharma.
